All 641 assignments replace modern scaffold actors for exactly 1444-11-11, preserving Mali, Tuareg, Songhai, Senegambian, Volta, Akan, Hausa, Yoruba, Benin, and local political fabrics.
Every assignment carries an evidence-bounded empire, kingdom, city-state network, confederation, or local-community grouping rather than a modern-state projection.
Date-valid records keep declining Mali, Tuareg Niger-bend control, pre-imperial Songhai, and the diverse savanna, forest, coast, and island fabrics distinct.
